overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Dehydrated Onion Chopped for wholesale, bulk, OEM, and export requirements. The product is made from selected onion bulbs, cleaned, trimmed, chopped, dehydrated, sieved, inspected, and packed in moisture-resistant food-grade packaging. It is offered for food processors, seasoning companies, restaurants, QSRs, importers, distributors, and private label brands.

This ingredient is designed for practical use in dry mixes, cooked foods, sauces, snacks, and seasoning systems. It is available in chopped pieces, with custom cut size on request. TradeNest Naturals supports custom mesh, packaging, samples, export documentation, and private label supply, with a minimum order quantity of 5 Kg and bulk packing options for commercial buyers.
